name: Parts for Kravel
summary: At the Mirage Raceway, Kravel Koalbeard awaits the package you carry from Wharfmaster Dizzywig. Dizzywig sends a warning with it: Kravel must pay his tab before he can receive more special orders.

sections.title: A Package and a Tab
sections.body: Wharfmaster Dizzywig gives you a package for Kravel Koalbeard at the Mirage Raceway. The Raceway lies in the Shimmering Flats of Thousand Needles. Dizzywig asks you to carry a warning with the package: Kravel must pay what he owes before he can receive more special orders.

sections.title: Kravel's Welcome
sections.body: Kravel welcomes the package and says it still needs to reach the gnomes. Before it travels any farther, he sets down the crate, removes one small item, and slips it into his pocket.

faq.q: Who gives you the package for Kravel?
aliases: where do the parts come from
faq.answer: Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet gives you Kravel's package and asks you to carry it to Kravel Koalbeard.

faq.q: Where does Kravel Koalbeard await the delivery?
aliases: where to turn in parts for kravel
faq.answer: Kravel Koalbeard awaits the delivery at the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles.

faq.q: What message does Dizzywig want delivered alongside the parts?
faq.answer: Dizzywig asks you to tell Kravel that he must pay his tab before he can receive more special orders.
Before bringing this package back, you carried Kravel's parts order to Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet.
